description: Image Description: The image shows a white Cuisinart SmartPower Pro blender base on a wooden countertop. The blender base has a control panel with several buttons, including "Stir," "Chop," "Mix," "On," "Off," "Pulse," "Ice Crush," and "Auto-Ice." A glass jar filled with a green, thick mixture—likely a smoothie or blended beverage—is attached to the base. The jar is partially inserted into the blender's motor
